workerResult.summary: Serif Storm — neo-brutalist kinetic-type storm. Gravity rains serif glyphs from a poetry corpus onto a poem bed with per-column landing stacks; typing anywhere bursts glyphs mid-air and Enter rains the buffered word; cursor movement/drag blows letters via a falloff wind field with live wind meter, plus a Gust shockwave button; Export renders a 1080x1350 framed poster PNG (masthead, canvas snapshot, poem, counts, date). Palette strictly 3 colors (red #FF3D00, blue #2545FF, yellow #FFC900) + ink/paper black/white. Verified: node syntax clean, headless Chromium zero page JS errors, layout fits at true 375px width (no overflow, single-column deck), full physics/input/export flow exercised in a Node DOM-stub harness with all assertions passing.
